marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices snapped a four-session losing streak on October 26, staging a sharp intraday reversal led by capital goods, private banking, and metals. The Nifty 50 recovered over 360 points from session lows to settle at 22,753.20 (+0.68%), while the BSE Sensex reclaimed 73,600 (+0.66%). The rebound was reinforced by moderating crude oil prices and net institutional buying by foreign institutional investors (FIIs net purchased ₹887.65 crore in Friday's session), providing immediate structural relief to swing bases across high-beta names.
dailyFocus: Watch for follow-through momentum on multi-week base breakouts in capital goods and defence names (notably CG Power post-earnings and BEL ahead of its October 30 board meeting). Focus on volume confirmation as indices attempt to establish higher swing lows above key technical support levels.

news.headline: Nifty Reclaims 22,750 Snapping Four-Day Slide as Crude Retreats and FIIs Turn Buyers
news.summary: The Nifty 50 staged a 360-point intraday turnaround on October 26, ending 153.20 points (+0.68%) higher at 22,753.20 after dropping to an opening trough of 22,387. The recovery was driven by Brent crude softening toward $114/bbl, selective buying in metals and private banks, and preliminary exchange data showing FII net inflows of ₹887.65 crore.
news.impact: Bullish reversal candle off short-term support increases follow-through probability for swing breakout candidates.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 Standalone Profit Rises 29% to ₹4,212 Crore; Asset Quality Improves
news.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank posted a 29% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹4,212 crore for Q2 FY27, supported by a 16% growth in Net Interest Income to ₹8,459 crore and a 15% reduction in provisions. Gross NPA improved to 1.04% from 1.39%. NIM compressed to 4.31% driven by massive ₹55,344 crore FCNR(B) deposit mobilization.
news.impact: Strong operating print and asset-quality improvements drove a 2.4% rally, spearheading short covering across banking swing structures.

news.headline: CG Power Q2 Net Profit Soars 44% to ₹409 Crore; Board Sanctions Multi-Unit Capex Expansion
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions reported a 44% YoY jump in consolidated Q2 net profit to ₹409.09 crore, with aggregate standalone sales rising 32% to ₹3,505 crore and EBITDA margin expanding to 18.2%. The board sanctioned fresh capex including GIS brownfield expansion at Nashik, EHV circuit breaker lines, and ₹68 crore to expand power transformer capacity by 10,000 MVA against an order backlog exceeding ₹21,800 crore.
news.impact: Decisive earnings beat backed by multi-quarter capex commits reinforces continuation momentum above base support.

news.headline: BEL Board to Meet on October 30 for Q2 Results Following ₹770 Crore Army Radar Win
news.summary: Bharat Electronics scheduled its board meeting for October 30, 2026, to review and approve Q2 financial results. Ahead of the meeting, the Ministry of Defence signed a ₹770 crore contract with BEL for Low Level Light Weight Radars for the Army, lifting cumulative order inflows since mid-October past ₹1,011 crore and strengthening revenue visibility into FY27.
news.impact: Order accretion ahead of scheduled October 30 earnings acts as a volatility catalyst for a range-bound breakout test.

news.headline: IAF and HAL Advance Tejas Mk1A Induction Clearance as Koraput Engine Capacity Doubles
news.summary: The Indian Air Force and HAL are finalizing technical integration assessments on radar weapon-controls for the Tejas Mk1A fighter jet. Meanwhile, the Ministry of Defence approved expansion of the Koraput Division's AL-31FP engine assembly to 50 units annually alongside a second Shakti helicopter engine manufacturing line to fulfill long-term defense delivery schedules.
news.impact: Resolution of delivery roadblocks sets the stage for volume expansion out of a multi-week consolidation base.

news.headline: BEL Commits ₹2,500 Crore to High-Tech Defence Manufacturing Facility in Andhra Pradesh
news.summary: Bharat Electronics confirmed a ₹2,500 crore greenfield investment across 914 acres in Sri Sathya Sai district, Andhra Pradesh. The ecosystem will host advanced manufacturing for radar and electronic warfare assemblies and generate substantial ancillary vendor demand.
news.impact: Long-term capex visibility underpins structural demand story for swing pullbacks into institutional support bands.

news.headline: Trent Gains Momentum Following 1,000th Zudio Store Milestone and ₹5,788 Crore Q2 Revenues
news.summary: Tata Group retailer Trent clocked a 23% YoY jump in provisional Q2 standalone revenue to ₹5,788 crore, crossing the landmark 1,000th Zudio outlet threshold. In parallel corporate filings on October 23, subsidiary Nahar Retail Trading Services entered into a binding term sheet to divest its holding in step-down entity Netria Property Holdings, sharpening retail capital allocation.
news.impact: Steady 20%+ top-line run-rate supports right-side formation of a broad base structure testing key psychological resistance.

news.headline: Adani Ports Incorporates Oman Unit for Indian Ocean Logistics; Flight Shift to NMIA Begins
news.summary: Adani Ports and SEZ incorporated Indian Ocean Gateway Terminal in Oman on October 21 via its international holding company to establish localized maritime operations. Meanwhile, major carriers IndiGo and Air India Express announced the phased transition of international West Asia routes to partner Navi Mumbai International Airport starting early 2027.
news.impact: Stock bounced +2.4% from moving average support, displaying fresh accumulation on international gateway expansion.

news.headline: ICICI Bank Posts 20% Net Profit Rise to ₹14,843 Crore; Net NPA Sits at Record 0.30%
news.summary: ICICI Bank recorded a 20.1% YoY increase in standalone Q2 PAT to ₹14,843 crore, led by 17.7% Net Interest Income expansion to ₹25,339 crore and healthy loan growth of 24.1% YoY (excluding offshore FCNR loans). Gross NPAs fell to 1.20% with net NPAs at 0.30%, while net interest margin trimmed to 4.18%.
news.impact: Pristine balance sheet metrics and steady core operating profit offer lower-risk swing continuation in the private banking basket.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Maps ₹6,000 Crore Capacity Expansion as Maritime Push Accelerates
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard is advancing plans for a ₹6,000 crore expansion across Vallarpadam and Thoothukudi to scale large-vessel steel fabrication and repair capacity. The initiative coincides with the central government's overseas delegation to South Korea to foster shipbuilding partnerships and subsidiary Hooghly-CSL's domestic luxury vessel wins.
news.impact: Multi-year capacity additions stabilize base building near ₹1,120-1,150 demand zone while awaiting Q2 operational numbers.
